newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones rose 78.50 points to 7,079.39. PLDT's ADR dipped $0 1/8 to $61 1/2.
* The peso closed lower at 26.329 to the dollar vs 26.323
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index inched up 2.89 points to 3,289.34.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.46875 percent.
